anomalies.observed: Both GND1 (pin 4) and GND2 (pin 5) of the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 are connected to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: GND1 should be on the logic ground (GND) and GND2 should be on a separate isolated ground (e.g., GND_ISO) to maintain galvanic isolation.

evidence.quote: GND [High Power] : ... U10.4(GND1,power_in) U10.5(GND2,power_in) ... U11.4(GND1,power_in) U11.5(GND2,power_in)
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver (U11/companion)

anomalies.impact: Defeats galvanic isolation, creating a common ground between the logic and CAN bus sides. This can cause ground loops, noise, and potential damage, and violates the intended isolated CAN interface.

anomalies.observed: The CAN termination switch SW6 is wired such that switch 1 (pins 1-2) connects R34.2 to R35.2, and switch 2 (pins 3-4) connects /CAN1_P to /CAN0_P. This shorts CAN0_P and CAN1_P when switch 2 is closed, and misconnects the 120R termination resistors.
anomalies.expected: Each 120R termination resistor should be switchable between its respective CANH and CANL lines: R34 between /CAN0_N and /CAN0_P, R35 between /CAN1_N and /CAN1_P. The switch should connect R34.2 to /CAN0_P and R35.2 to /CAN1_P.
anomalies.impact: When termination is enabled, CAN0_P and CAN1_P are shorted together, causing bus contention and failure of both CAN buses. The termination resistors are also not correctly placed across the differential pairs, so proper termination is not provided.

anomalies.observed: The netlist lists the MPN for U15, U22, U35, U36 as U74LVC1G125G-AL5-R, which is a 3-state buffer, while the library part is named SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1.
anomalies.expected: The specification states these are SN74LVC1G07, which are open-drain buffers.

evidence.quote: single non-inverting buffers (SN74LVC1G07, parts U15, U22, U35, U36) wired as /OE-controlled sinks

U15 | SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1 | Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-353_SC-70-5 | acorn-motherboard:SN74LVC1G07QDCKTQ1 |  | Digikey=TC7SH34FULJ(CTCT-ND, MPN=U74LVC1G125G-AL5-R, LCSC=C171458, Manufacturer=UTC(Unisonic Tech)

anomalies.impact: If assembled with the MPN, the buffers will be 3-state instead of open-drain, changing the e-stop sink behavior and potentially affecting the e-stop chain.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies. The most severe are the isolated CAN transceivers U10 and U11 having their logic and bus grounds tied together, defeating isolation, and the CAN termination switch SW6 being cross-wired, which would short CAN0_P to CAN1_P and misplace the termination resistors. Additionally, the e-stop buffers U15/U22/U35/U36 have an MPN that specifies a 3-state buffer instead of the specified open-drain SN74LVC1G07.
